vacancyList.postName: Senior Accounts Officer / Senior Internal Auditor (AC-04)

howToApply: Visit OIL’s official website (www.oil-india.com) and click on the ‘Click Here’ hyperlink to initiate registration.

Step-I: Register by filling Personal Details and Contact Details. An OTP will be sent to your registered Mobile No. and E-mail ID. Enter both OTPs to verify. Accept terms & conditions and click Submit. You will receive an Application Sequence No. (User ID) and Password.

Step-II: Re-login using User ID and Password. Fill in Personal Details, Additional Details, Communication Details, Qualification Details, Experience Details, and Declaration. Upload scanned photograph (JPG/JPEG, 100KB–200KB, 3.5cm x 4.5cm) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 80KB–150KB).
Preview the application and verify all details. Edit if required before final submission.

Submit the application. After submission, pay the applicable non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- (plus applicable taxes) via SBI e-Pay Lite Payment Gateway. SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen are exempted from fee.
After successful payment, print/save the submitted Application Form in PDF for future reference.
Ensure your e-mail ID and mobile number remain valid throughout the recruitment process.
For technical queries, contact Help Desk at Phone No: 9513253397 (Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM).
